name: Ästad - Vessigebro
description: Ästad to Vessigebro. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
waterSources: Dricksvatten Ästad Vingård: Official drinking-water point at Ästad Vingård area. Treat as tap refill/service context at the venue rather than remote public spring.
Dricksvatten Vessigebro: Official water point at Vessigebro endpoint service cluster near ICA.
notes: Official Hallandsleden page/API says 21 km and red/hard; GPX desc says Total: 21.2 km with computed 21.157 km; Naturkartan visible page says 24.0 km and black/experienced; Pacer/Komoot/Äventyrligare preserve old Ästad-Skattagård 22-24 km style evidence.

Official GPX/API geo_json and Naturkartan shape have the current 214-point Byasjön/Ästad-to-Vessigebro line. API line.geometry and OSM relation 7398314 preserve old Ästad-Skattagård linework that starts east of the current start and continues beyond Vessigebro.

Official listing/page previous relationship puts Rydöbruk - Kvarnforsen before Ästad - Vessigebro, but those endpoints are about 44.097 km apart. The actual physical inbound handoff is N7/Åkulla - Ästad, whose endpoint is 0.2 m from M7 start.

Page/service narrative and API include Skattagård shelter/camp and broad off-route services, but Skattagård is about 2.62 km from current M7 GPX and belongs to old Ästad-Skattagård/next-stage context.
The GPX starts at Byasjön shelter, but this is not drive-up access. Naturkartan says parking at the shelter is unsuitable and access parking is offset through Skogsbo/Holma ö style points.
Fire-ban layer returned no fire ban on 2026-04-29, while Räddningstjänsten Väst showed Brandrisk 3/olämpligt att elda; Långanskogen has reserve-specific fire rules.
